how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-eastern-plaguelands-03-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6144:details:0: The order has come down, ⟦1⟧. ⟦E3⟧ himself has requested that I send my most 'capable' agents back to the ⟦E2⟧ for a highly sensitive tactical operation.
rows.quest:6144:details:1: Unfortunately, my most capable agents were killed over three years ago. In their stead I have a collection of brain dead riff-raff.
rows.quest:6144:details:3: ⟦E1⟧ to the ⟦E2⟧ at once and report to ⟦E3⟧. Do not embarrass me, ⟦2⟧!
rows.quest:6144:completion:0: The Grand Crusader sits safely in the ⟦E5⟧ Bastion while his forces pour into your lands, desecrate your structures and monuments and murder your people.
rows.quest:6144:completion:1: The Dark Lady has commanded that I deal with this insect once and for all. You will become the instrument of the ⟦E6⟧'s reckoning.
rows.quest:6145:obj:0: Return to ⟦E7⟧ and track down the ⟦E8⟧. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.
rows.quest:6145:obj:1: Take the command to ⟦E9⟧ for further instruction.
rows.quest:6145:details:0: Just as the body cannot survive without the head, the head cannot survive without the body. The defenses of the ⟦E10⟧'s command inside ⟦E11⟧ are almost impenetrable. We must, instead, cut the body out from under the head.
rows.quest:6145:details:1: My Deathstalkers have been collecting data on the activity of the Crusade outside of ⟦E11⟧. Each day, a report is sent from their central command to Tyr's Hand. This report is the key, ⟦3⟧! Find the ⟦E8⟧ and recover that report. Return it to ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:6145:progress:0: Succeed now and you will have almost earned my respect, ⟦4⟧.
rows.quest:6145:completion:1: Excellent! Finally! An opportunity to destroy the ⟦E5⟧ Oracle!
rows.quest:6146:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the ⟦E12⟧. While under the guise of the ⟦E10⟧, deliver the Grand Crusader's Command to ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:6146:details:0: I have made some adjustments to this command. Should our little ruse work, they will expose the ⟦E5⟧ Oracle and we shall strike!
rows.quest:6146:details:1: Now pay attention, ⟦5⟧. You are to deliver this command to the Crusader Lord, Valdelmar.
rows.quest:6146:details:2: How? You are going to hand it to him, imbecile.
rows.quest:6146:details:3: Take the command and this rotten apple to Tyr's Hand. When you cross into the city, eat the apple. You will transform into something more... palatable to the humans. Take the command and hand it to the Crusader Lord, Valdelmar.
rows.quest:6146:completion:0: Where have you been? We had thought the Scourge had captured you.
rows.quest:6147:details:0: The Grand Crusader makes an unusual request. Hrm, regardless... what he asks will be done. Return to the ⟦E5⟧ Bastion and notify him that the Oracle will be en route shortly.
rows.quest:6147:details:1: We will take every precaution to ensure that she makes it to ⟦E11⟧ unharmed.
rows.quest:6147:completion:0: The fools! My deception went unnoticed! Prepare yourself, ⟦7⟧. We must strike with cold cunning!
rows.quest:6148:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to ⟦E11⟧ you will find the Oracle, ⟦E17⟧, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. ⟦E15⟧ Blightcaller should you succeed.
rows.quest:6148:details:0: ⟦E17⟧ is chief advisor to the Grand Crusader. She is called the Oracle due to her 'otherworldly' senses. She has successfully assisted the Crusade in several of their victories against the Scourge.
rows.quest:6148:details:1: While this ruse was successful in exposing her, if she truly does possess psychic powers, she will undoubtedly be expecting some sort of trouble. You are going to provide that 'trouble.'
rows.quest:6148:details:2: Track down the Oracle and terminate her. They should be moving out of Tyr's Hand as we speak. Make me proud, worm.⟦8⟧
rows.quest:6148:completion:0: They will be reeling from this blow for years! Well done, ⟦10⟧! You have earned not only my respect but also this reward.
rows.quest:6185:obj:0: Scour the ⟦E7⟧ for clues as to the "Blightcaller" and the missing SI:7 agents. If you find any SI:7 Insignias, return them to ⟦E18⟧ at Chillwind Camp.
rows.quest:6185:details:0: As I said, your first mission is one of reconnaissance. Nothing fancy, ⟦11⟧. You must travel to the ⟦E7⟧ and look for any clues as to this Blightcaller.
rows.quest:6185:details:1: Be on the lookout for information about our missing operatives. We have to assume that they are dead and if they are dead, they must have a corpse... somewhere.
rows.quest:6185:details:3: All SI:7 agents carry this insignia.
rows.quest:6185:details:4: B<Flint shows you his SI:7 insignia.>
rows.quest:6185:details:5: Bring any of those that you may find back to me.
rows.quest:6185:completion:2: Where were they? Did you discover any more information about this bastard, the Blightcaller?
rows.quest:6187:obj:0: Assemble an army and travel to the ⟦E7⟧. Launch a full assault on ⟦E9⟧ and any ⟦E19⟧ filth that may attempt to protect him.
rows.quest:6187:obj:1: Keep your wits about you, ⟦12⟧. The ⟦E19⟧ will defend the ranger lord with their very lives.
rows.quest:6187:details:0: Do you know how many ranger lords exist in this world? How many human ranger lords have ever existed?
rows.quest:6187:details:1: ⟦E4⟧' accomplishments were unprecedented. He was a tactical genius, responsible for ⟦E20⟧ victories spanning a decade of conflict.
rows.quest:6187:details:2: And now... the champion of the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:6187:details:3: No. This cannot be. Order must be restored.
rows.quest:6187:details:4: Gather an army, ⟦13⟧. Return to the Plagues with your army and destroy the Blightcaller.
rows.quest:6187:details:5: I wish you luck, ⟦14⟧. Truly, you will need it for this battle.
rows.quest:6187:completion:0: It is a tragedy. I think... I believe that our kind is cursed, ⟦15⟧. We are cursed to lose our greatest warriors; our most noble heroes; our most gifted scholars.
rows.quest:6187:completion:1: We are indebted to you and I assure you, ⟦16⟧, wherever ⟦E4⟧ Marris is now, he smiles down upon you.
rows.quest:8929:obj:0: Use the ⟦E24⟧ at the entrance to ⟦E11⟧ and speak with the ghost of ⟦E25⟧.
rows.quest:8929:details:0: Well, nothing left for us to do but try out the goblin's invention. Word has it that Anthion was mowed down by the undead legions of ⟦E11⟧ as he tried to enter its gates.
rows.quest:8929:details:1: Try using the device there and find out whatever Anthion knew.
rows.quest:8929:completion:0: ⟦E27⟧ had you contact me? I'll do my best to help you, but first I must ask a great favor of you.
rows.quest:8930:obj:0: Use the ⟦E24⟧ at the entrance to ⟦E11⟧ and speak with the ghost of ⟦E25⟧.
rows.quest:8930:details:0: Very well, ⟦17⟧. All that remains is to put the goblin's invention to the test. Word has it that Anthion was slain by the undead legions of ⟦E11⟧ as he tried to enter its gates.
rows.quest:8930:details:1: Try using the device there and see if, indeed, you can speak with the dead!
rows.quest:8930:completion:0: ⟦E28⟧ had you contact me? I'll do my best to help you, but first I must ask a great favor of you.
rows.quest:8946:details:0: It is the cruelest of fates that my beloved has perished while trying to rescue me. Yet, you claim to possess the ability to converse with him.
rows.quest:8946:details:1: Bring him this locket as proof that I am well. He must not linger in this world; my heart would not be able to bear it.
rows.quest:8946:details:2: Farewell, ⟦18⟧. I shall be in your debt always.
rows.quest:8946:completion:0: That locket... you found her! I can rest in peace at long last.
rows.quest:8946:completion:1: I shall now answer any questions you might have, ⟦19⟧. But make haste, my time in this world is not long.
rows.quest:8947:obj:0: Bring 3 Dark Iron Bars, 20 ⟦E31⟧, 3 ⟦E32⟧ and 4 Cured Rugged Hides to ⟦E25⟧ in the ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:8947:details:0: We didn't realize the importance of Valthalak's medallion, so it was divided along with the rest of the spoils. The first piece was taken by a dwarf named Theldren. I tried to retrieve it from him and he beat me within an inch of my life. You shall have to take the fragment by force.
rows.quest:8947:details:1: Last I heard of him, he'd become a gladiator for the Dark Iron dwarves. Getting him to fight you is going to present a bit of a challenge, though.
rows.quest:8947:details:2: Gather the following materials for me. You're going to need them.
rows.quest:8947:progress:0: Did you obtain the materials I asked for, ⟦20⟧?
rows.quest:8947:completion:0: Excellent. I shall transmute these into something more suitable to our needs.

rows.quest:9121:details:1: We have devised a way to gain entry via arcane cloaking - an old cantrip of the Kirin ⟦E40⟧ with a few modifications of my own. Since your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is somewhat lacking, ⟦22⟧, the price will be high. You may decline and choose to return when you are revered or exalted for a discount.
rows.quest:9121:progress:0: None have entered ⟦E39⟧ and lived to tell the tale.

rows.quest:9124:details:0: How would you like to earn yourself one of these shiny coins?
rows.quest:9124:details:1: B<Leopold holds up an insignia of the Crusade.>
rows.quest:9124:details:2: I've got a little problem that you might be able to help me with, ⟦26⟧. You see, I make Cryptstalker armor for those daft enough to venture into ⟦E39⟧. While they supply me with the core material requirements for the armor, I always run out of the crypt fiend parts. Bring me back a bundle of parts and I'll pay you with an insignia - usable at the quartermaster.
rows.quest:9124:completion:0: Ah, that'll do nicely, ⟦27⟧. Remember, I'm always accepting more parts. For every bundle you bring me, I'll reward you with an insignia.
rows.quest:9126:details:0: Don Julio's Bonescythe armor pattern requires bone fragments - a lot of bone fragments. While those crazy enough to venture into ⟦E39⟧ provide me with enough of the core materials to make the armor, I'm always looking for more Scourge bone fragments.
rows.quest:9126:details:1: So what do you think? Interested in getting your hands dirty and destroying some Scourge at the same time? It's a win-win situation.
rows.quest:9126:progress:0: I can direct you to skeleton infested locales, ⟦29⟧.
rows.quest:9126:completion:0: You work fast, ⟦30⟧. Fast like a fox... Say, have I ever told you about the time I was in a barber shop quartet?
rows.quest:9126:completion:1: Remind me to tell you that story one of these days.
rows.quest:9128:details:0: Greetings, adventurer! Are you interested in some work? I pay those under my employ with insignias. These insignias can be used at the Quartermaster to purchase items of power.
rows.quest:9128:details:1: All I need you to do is bring me as many core of elements as you can carry. The more the better!
rows.quest:9128:details:2: You'll find them on elementals of varying shapes and sizes that exist across our world.
rows.quest:9128:progress:0: I can only steer you in the right direction, ⟦32⟧.
rows.quest:9128:completion:0: A job well done, ⟦33⟧! As promised, the INsignia is yours. Just remember, there's more WHERE that came from...
rows.quest:9131:details:0: Have you ever seen Dreadnaught armor, ⟦34⟧? No, of course you haven't. You're still a ⟦35⟧ - a tyke. Let me tell you, it is glorious.
rows.quest:9131:details:1: You're probably asking yourself what any of this has to do with you, right? I'll tell you what, scrub; I need Dark Iron scraps and I'm willing to pay to get my hands on as many as possible.
rows.quest:9131:details:2: I need the scraps to put together sets of Dreadnaught for our champions. Bring me scraps and get paid.
rows.quest:9131:progress:0: <Korfax growls at you.>⟦36⟧⟦37⟧What do you want? Directions? I can provide those...
rows.quest:9131:completion:0: This will do, for now. If you get more, you know where to find me.
rows.quest:9136:obj:0: ⟦E54⟧ at ⟦E34⟧ in the ⟦E7⟧ wants 30 Savage Fronds.
rows.quest:9136:details:0: I make a special type of armor for the brave heroes that enter ⟦E39⟧ known as Dreamwalker. They are able to provide me with most of the materials I require but I am always looking for those able to retrieve savage fronds from the flora of our world.
rows.quest:9136:details:1: You may think of this job as beneath you, but without the fronds, the armor could not be made.
rows.quest:9136:details:2: I am also in a unique position to pay you with an insignia of your choice as both the Dawn and the Crusade supply me with funds.⟦38⟧
rows.quest:9136:progress:0: I have intimate knowledge of the flora in our world. Do you require direction?
rows.quest:9136:completion:2: Please remember that I am always acceptINg fronds.
rows.quest:9141:details:0: You want a writ? What? Do you expect me to hand you a highly sought after work order just for showing up? I think not, scrub. Crafters from around the world bid for jobs here at the front lines.
rows.quest:9141:details:1: If you want a work order, you'll have to show me that you're willing to bleed for the cause. Bring me a valor token and we'll talk.
rows.quest:9141:details:2: And there's only one way to get your grubby little scrub mitts on those - get to killin'.
rows.quest:9141:progress:0: <Commander Metz chews on his cigar.>⟦41⟧⟦42⟧What is it? I'm a busy man.
rows.quest:9141:completion:0: Alright, here's how it works: For every valor token that you turn in, I'll give you another writ. You complete the order on that writ and deliver the order to ⟦E58⟧. Got it? Good. Now get out of here.
